claims.claim: Two ATP titles: Adelaide January 2024 and Brisbane January 2025
Career high No. 12 in May 2026, after first Masters 1000 final in Miami (March 2026)
claims.note: ATP bio confirms No. 12 in May 2026; Miami report dated March 27, 2026.

claims.claim: Born in Mladá Boleslav, Czech Republic

claims.note: ČTK caption 'Český tenista Jiří Lehečka'; ATP page refers to Czech men.

claims.claim: Mother and grandfather; left home at 15 for Prostějov; 2019 Wimbledon boys' doubles with Forejtek
Adelaide 2024: seventh seed, beat Jack Draper 4-6, 6-4, 6-3 in 2h08, maiden title, set to No. 23
Brisbane 2025: led Opelka 4-1 when he retired with back injury; rose four places to No. 24; Opelka quote
2023 Australian Open: beat sixth seed Auger-Aliassime 4-6, 6-3, 7-6(2), 7-6(3) in round of 16
US Open 2025: beat Mannarino 7-6(4), 6-4, 2-6, 6-2 in 3h14, first US Open quarter-final (31 August 2025)
claims.note: Score, duration, first quarter-final and date confirmed.

claims.claim: Top 20 in September 2025; No. 24 after Brisbane; No. 14 in Miami March 2026
Miami 2026: 21st seed; beat Arthur Fils 6-2, 6-2 in 75 minutes; first Masters 1000 final; title would take him to No. 12
